steps.code:
import os
import re

base_dir = "/home/sierra/documents/work/meetings_data/"
files_to_move = []

for entry in directory_contents:
    if entry.endswith("/"):
        continue
    # Get the filename relative to the base directory
    rel_path = os.path.relpath(entry, base_dir)
    filename = os.path.basename(rel_path)
    # Parse the filename: <date>__<file_name>.<extension>
    match = re.match(r"^([^_]+)__(.+)\.(.+)$", filename)
    if match:
        date_part = match.group(1)
        file_name_part = match.group(2)
        extension = match.group(3)
        files_to_move.append({
            "source": entry,
            "dest_dir": os.path.join(base_dir, file_name_part),
            "dest_file": os.path.join(base_dir, file_name_part, f"{date_part}.{extension}"),
            "file_name_part": file_name_part,
            "date_part": date_part,
            "extension": extension
        })

print(files_to_move)
